order_statement: Written BEFORE any simulation of Ours-v3 on dev traces. Before this file only: toy unit tests of ours_v3.py (hand-computed cost tables), cost-table break-even analysis (per-shape payback counts, key-sharing credit) and the first-sight SHAPE ORDER of two dev traces (W2/W3 N=1e4 seed 0; no outcomes) were run. S3 evaluation traces (seeds 100-109) and the new evaluation seeds 110-119 were never read by this step; the executor read goals/.. ANALYSIS_3.3_opus.txt (quotes S3 evaluation numbers for the mechanism) as background.

policy.name: Ours-v3
policy.base: S3 Ours v2 (code/p24/policy/ours.py SHA16 03f9ad80c392b842, unchanged); v3 = v2 + payback gate K_pay + alpha_c1
policy.unit_tests: code/tests/test_policy_v3_S4P.py (SHA16 930abb208cb5b41b at prereg; toy tests green)
policy.payback_gate: For a shape served eagerly (no compiled code, no graph): n_star = U_C1(s | cache mode, compiled keys of this process) / (steady_E0 - steady_C1), from the cost table via CostView.one_time_s('C1', s, compiled_keys=state.compiled_keys); n_star <= K_pay -> Action(COMPILE) at once (first sight, evaluated at every request while the shape is still eager). Else v2 unchanged.
policy.alpha_c1: ski-rental fraction of the memory-free C1 tier in the online path (None = alpha). Graph tiers keep alpha.

simulator: Same as the S3 3.3 main simulator: p24/sim/simulator.py (frozen) + cost table + 3.1b addendum overlay (p24.sim.addendum, install_simulator_hook), default budget, overhead-aware admission, prior_A; cold levels as sim_eval_S3: disk = cache_mode warm, empty = cache_mode empty with --missing impute semantics (flagged imputed=1; S3 AUTO_DECISIONS 2026-11-17: missing cold_empty cells imputed from the disk-cache value x median measured empty/disk ratio of the arm), hot = warm with the first shape also at the in-process tier.
candidates_note: At most 4 groups (pre-registration). All other parameters = v2 frozen params above (alpha=1.0, H_prior=1000, online horizon, four tiers, ...). K_pay is in requests of the shape (predicted payback count); K=30 admits at first sight only shapes whose one-time cost is nearly covered by key sharing (disk cache) -> bounded regret <= 30 x saving per shape; K=100 admits roughly the cheaper half of the shapes of a disk-cache process.
simplicity_note: fewest deviations from v2 first (g1, g2: only the gate; g3, g4: gate + alpha_c1), then the smaller K (less speculative) first.

objective_primary.name: O1
objective_primary.definition: geometric mean of the total service time (s) over W1-W5 x N in {1e3, 1e4} x seeds 0-4 = 50 dev traces (half A), disk-cache level (cache_mode warm), default budget

objective_second.name: O2
objective_second.definition: same 50 dev traces, empty-cache level (cache_mode empty, imputed table as S3 main evaluation), default budget; used as a CONSTRAINT (cold-start must not degrade): eligible iff O2(candidate) <= 1.005 x O2(v2)
objective_second.v2: Ours with the S3 frozen params (= OursV3 with K_pay=0, alpha_c1=None; bit-for-bit equality is a unit test)

selection_rule: 1) eligible = candidates with O2(candidate) <= 1.005 x O2(v2). 2) best = lowest O1 among eligible. 3) selected = the SIMPLEST (simplicity_order) eligible candidate with O1 <= 1.01 x O1(best) ('difference < 1% -> simplest'). 4) If no candidate is eligible, freeze the candidate with the lowest O2/O2(v2), flag 'constraint_violated' in policy_params_v3.json and the report. No other criterion enters the selection.

report_only_diagnostics.note: Do NOT enter the selection. Dev data only (half A, seeds 0-4); extra N are generated in memory from the A half pool with the S2/S3 generator (flagged trace_kind=gen_default, as sim_eval_S3 --dev-extra-N); no eval trace is touched.
report_only_diagnostics.dev_H5_style_table: cell means (W1-W5 x {empty, disk, hot} x N in {1e2, 1e3, 1e4, 1e5}) over dev seeds: v3/B1, v3/B0, v3/v2, v3/best-online (best online = B1,B2,B3,B3p,B3pp,B4,B5,B6,B6p as scripts/h4_verdict_S3.py ONLINE); max over cells
report_only_diagnostics.dev_H5a_style: W2 N=1e4 disk: per dev seed v3/B1 and the number of seeds <= 1.01 and < 1
report_only_diagnostics.mid_N: N = 3e3 (generated in memory, all workloads, 3 colds) to expose any cliff between the grid points

revision_clause: If the dev run shows a design flaw (e.g. dev-style W2 N=1e4 v3/B1 stays > 1.03 for every candidate, or an implementation error), a revised candidate set may be written to a NEW file params_prereg_rev2.json BEFORE the next run, with the reason and the first-pass numbers kept; this file and the first-pass raw outputs are never overwritten (S3 3.2b precedent).
